# Runtime dependencies for the awesome-benzi scripts.
# Install:  pip install -r requirements.txt
# External binaries (not pip-installable) are detected at runtime:
#   LibreOffice (soffice)  - optional render review (DOCX -> PDF)
#   Poppler (pdftoppm)     - optional render review (PDF -> PNG)
#   Tesseract              - optional local OCR for scanned PDFs
# Word COM recovery and Windows OCR need no extra package on Windows
# (pywin32 is optional and preferred over the PowerShell fallback).

python-docx>=1.1.0
Pillow>=10.0.0
pypdf>=4.0.0
pdfplumber>=0.11.0
pywin32>=306; sys_platform == "win32"
